ModRattlebones.name: Rattlebones
ModRattlebones.attack: Lob your skull: it stays where it lands and bites
ModRattlebones.special: Collapse into a bone pile and heal
passive: While your skull is out, only the skull can be hit
Swipe headless to call your skull home

ModMarrowHound.name: Marrow Hound
ModMarrowHound.special: Howl: a bleed ring round you, then sprint
passive: Run faster at a bleeding hero
When hurt, a bone pile heals you a great deal

ModCairnCrow.name: Cairn Crow
ModCairnCrow.special: Caw: bone piles near you hop toward your kin
passive: Peck a bleeding hero: a splinter falls as a pile
Bone piles crawl to you: eat one for a plate

ModBoneLancer.name: Bone Lancer
ModBoneLancer.special: Throw three spears in a fan
passive: Your spears stand in the floor and snag him
Standing spears crumble into bone piles

ModOssGravedigger.name: Gravedigger
ModOssGravedigger.attack: Spade swing that flings grave dirt
ModOssGravedigger.special: Unearth: dig two bone piles out of the floor
passive: Two quick spade hits bury him to the knees
Buried, he moves slowly for a moment
ModOssGravedigger.vault: Two spade blows in quick succession bury its victim to the knees

ModOssGravetusk.name: Gravetusk
ModOssGravetusk.attack: Tusk gore that tosses the hero back
ModOssGravetusk.special: Charge: trampled piles burst into shards
passive: Your charge bends to a bleeding hero
Piles ahead of your charge glow before they burst

ModOssBarghest.name: Barghest
ModOssBarghest.special: Pounce (can't be hit): land past him, facing him
passive: Bite him from behind to hit harder
Your eyes flare while you are behind him
ModOssBarghest.vault: Leaps over its prey and bites from behind, where it hurts most

ModOssuaryPriest.name: Ossuary Priest
ModOssuaryPriest.attack: Slow marrow bolt that homes in on the hero
ModOssuaryPriest.special: Raise nearby bone piles as rats
passive: Bones come to you from further, and faster
They wait at your feet for Raise. Kin may eat them

ModOssCarrionVulture.name: Carrion Vulture
ModOssCarrionVulture.attack: Swoop through the hero, raking; may bleed
ModOssCarrionVulture.special: Plummet (can't be hit): drop on his marked spot
passive: When he's below half health, you're faster
and your rake always bleeds

ModOssCharnelRider.name: Charnel Rider
ModOssCharnelRider.special: Joust: gallop a long way or into a wall, then wheel
passive: Badly hurt, your horse falls: fight on foot
On foot: throw your lance, run in with a thrust

ModOssSpinehook.name: Spinehook
ModOssSpinehook.special: Harpoon: it bites the hero or a bone pile
passive: Harpoon a bone pile and reel it in through him
A pile reeled in to you becomes a plate
ModOssSpinehook.vault: Harpoons bone piles and hauls them home, through anyone in the way

ModOssTombwright.name: Tombwright
ModOssTombwright.attack: Mallet smash; knocks over a headstone it hits
ModOssTombwright.special: Raise three headstones in a line at the hero
passive: Raise headstones, then mallet them over onto him
A falling stone topples the next, then breaks to bones
ModOssTombwright.vault: Raises headstones as walls, then knocks them over like dominoes

ModOssCoffinBearer.name: Coffin Bearer
ModOssCoffinBearer.special: Whirl: up to three hits, then you are dizzy
passive: Press again mid-whirl to let the coffin fly
It flies out on its chain and you skip the daze
ModOssCoffinBearer.vault: Whirls a coffin on its chains, and sometimes lets it fly

ModOssBoneMammoth.name: Bone Mammoth
ModOssBoneMammoth.special: Cross Quake: rear, stamp, spikes along a cross
passive: Your stamp splits the floor in a cross
Each footfall jolts the floor round your foot
ModOssBoneMammoth.vault: The floor shakes under every step. Its stamp splits the ground in a cross

ModOssRazorback.name: Razorback
ModOssRazorback.special: Skid: fire every raised quill ahead in a fan
passive: Run to raise your quills
Each second of standing still lowers a quill
ModOssRazorback.vault: Its quills rise one by one as it runs, and fly when it skids

ModOssCerberus.name: Cerberus
ModOssCerberus.attack: Three heads bite at once in a fan
ModOssCerberus.special: Three gas cones sweep in and poison
passive: Your three breaths sweep in and meet on him
The outer heads glow first: the way out is back
ModOssCerberus.vault: Three heads breathe grave gas from both sides at once. The only way out is back

ModOssChurchGrim.name: Church Grim
ModOssChurchGrim.special: Graveward Lunge: run through him; may bleed
passive: Once, when slain, you rise from your bones
If he stands on your bones meanwhile, you're gone
ModOssChurchGrim.vault: Falls into its bones once, eyes lit, and rises unless someone stands on them

ModOssCarrionSaint.name: Carrion Saint
ModOssCarrionSaint.attack: Send a perched crow at the hero
ModOssCarrionSaint.special: Murder: the whole flock bursts out at the hero
passive: Your perched crows are your shots. Bones bring more
Up to four perch, and lost ones come back

ModOssuary.name: The Ossuary
ModOssuary.attack: Fists slam a ring of spikes ahead
ModOssuary.special: Ribcage: six ribs burst up round him
passive: Cage him in ribs. He breaks one to get out
You hold up to three plates: soak his way out

ModOssMarrowWyrm.name: Marrow Wyrm
ModOssMarrowWyrm.special: Neck Lash: cock back, then sweep the arc in front
passive: Piles near you give two plates, not one
Red lines show the piles you filled with marrow

ModOssCarrionRoc.name: Carrion Roc
ModOssCarrionRoc.special: Airlift: fly a friend or a pile onto the hero
passive: Fly a friend to the hero and drop them on him
They land with a plate. Their shadow marks the spot
ModOssCarrionRoc.vault: Carries its kin through the air and drops them on its prey

ModBoneRat.name: Bone Rat
passive: Raised from a bone pile
